# EffeTune documentation snapshot (Japanese)

- Source: https://github.com/Frieve-A/effetune (MIT License, see LICENSE in this folder)
- Commit: 03bffda352287f4f438d063d9660aad7864e553a
- Why this commit: it is the `external/effetune` submodule of EffeTune Mixwright v0.12.0,
  release commit 6f4e2ee, the VST3 build bundled with mImageViewer. This replaces the
  pre-release bundle snapshot; no released EffeTune state needs migration (user decision).
- Contents: `docs/i18n/ja/` copied verbatim into `ja/`, plus only the four images the
  Japanese docs reference from `images/`. Staged from the upstream commit tarball.
- Do not edit these files. mIV-specific corrections live in the override files used by
  the conversion script, so a new snapshot can replace this folder as a whole.
